note: Synthetic frames of a CHZZK chat socket (docs/modules/M5.16-chzzk.md), read for chat channel chatChannelId. Each case is one or more frames in order: {"text": ...} is a text frame, {"b64": ...} a binary frame; "note" says what a frame is for. Written by fixtures/chzzk/danmaku/synthetic_cases.py; names, ids, tokens and times are made up.

cases.name: a chat line with every field
three lines in one frame, the member count changing
donations pushed live (93102): named, anonymous by user and by flag, without text, a video

frames.note: uid "anonymous" and profile null, as S11-recent records them
flagged anonymous but carrying a user id and profile

cases.name: subscriptions with and without a message, a subscription gift
a system line (a notice since B-12); images, stickers, parties and shop purchases show nothing

frames.note: a sticker whose extras carry payAmount

cases.name: hidden lines: BLIND, CBOTBLIND, HIDDEN; a line without a status
the recent chat (15101): its field names; an answer that is not retCode 0
the answer to the join: accepted, without a session id, refused, to be retried, without a code

frames.note: as the server answers a chat channel that does not exist, then closes (1000 Bye)

cases.name: the server's ping, the pong, the end of the session
a blind (a retraction since B-12), a pinned notice (a notice since B-12); events, kicks and penalties show nothing

frames.note: a chat frame sent as binary
a binary frame with bytes that are not UTF-8 in the text

cases.name: times: milliseconds, zero, negative, beyond DateTime, text, a fraction
a frame of another chat channel is read as it is (the site's client does not check)
